heading: Art. 5. Territorial applicability of this chapter
lead: This chapter applies in all places.

notes.text: Historical and Revision Notes Revised sectionSource (U.S. Code)Source (Statutes at Large) 80550:555.May 5, 1950, ch. 169, § 1 (Art. 5), 64 Stat. 110. The word “applies” is substituted for the words “shall be applicable”.
